channel.title: ARLing: printable puzzles, spreadsheets and games

item.title: A 10 pt floor for type sounds arbitrary until you read a book on e-ink in a car
item.description: A 10 pt floor for type sounds arbitrary until you read a book on e-ink in a car. We cap every file at that floor and count the characters below it, which is 0 in Morning Quiet. #eink #Typesetting #LogicPuzzles

item.title: Adding writable fields to a PDF can move the drawing underneath by a pixel
item.description: Adding writable fields to a PDF can move the drawing underneath by a pixel. We render the page before and after and compare them, and for Ben-Hur the pixels came back identical. #eink #Typesetting #LogicPuzzles

item.description: Meet the suspects: five garden helpers, and only one was at the kitchen window. A printable detective party game for kids aged 8 to 12 with suspect cards, evidence cards, a code wheel and a logic grid. PDF, 6.90 €. #KidsParty #PrintableGame #DetectiveGame #BirthdayParty

item.title: Counting links in a PDF is not the same as counting links in the HTML that made it
item.description: Counting links in a PDF is not the same as counting links in the HTML that made it. We count both: 598 in the finished Puzzle Post file, and the same number in the source. When they differ, something was lost in the export. #eink #Typesetting #LogicPuzzles
